Files: encoder.onnx and decoder.onnx are the 8-bit quantized ONNX export of
moonshine-tiny-ar (https://huggingface.co/UsefulSensors/moonshine-tiny-ar),
taken unchanged from https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/moonshine-tiny-ar-ONNX
(encoder_model_quantized.onnx and decoder_model_merged_quantized.onnx).
vocab.json is the token list of the model's tokenizer.json, saved in a smaller
form; it was not otherwise changed. The model weights were not modified.
